title: Get all Next of kins Service

cues.en: In the previous lecture, we handled the migration issues that we had.
cues.zh: 上一堂處理了遷移問題。

cues.en: But a point to note is if we realized when we rolled the migrations, we dropped the profile table, meaning we lost the profile data and we had to recreate the profile, then the next of kin.
cues.zh: 不過要注意，退回遷移時刪除了 profile 表，所以個人資料遺失，必須重新建立個人資料，再建立近親資料。

cues.en: This should not be the case, especially in production environments.
cues.zh: 尤其在正式環境中，不應該發生這種情況。

cues.en: So in production environments first, always make sure that your data is backed up before running any migrations.
cues.zh: 因此在正式環境執行任何遷移前，一定要先備份資料。

cues.en: Then you can always also test the migrations in a staging environment first before heading to production.
cues.zh: 也可以先在預備環境測試遷移，再部署正式環境。

cues.en: Also, if you go back to our migration, which is the ad profile table migration, in this migration within the downgrade function, we can only consider one keeping the table but removing constraints
cues.zh: 另外，回到 add_profile_table 遷移中的 downgrade 函式，可以考慮第一種方式，保留資料表但移除約束。

cues.en: or two.
cues.zh: 或者第二種。

cues.en: We could as well comment out this drop table command so that we don't lose our data.
cues.zh: 將 drop_table 命令註解掉，避免資料遺失。

cues.en: So I just wanted you to be aware of that so that in production environments, please make sure your data is backed up before running any migrations or test the migrations in a staging environment first
cues.zh: 我想提醒各位，正式環境執行遷移前，請先備份資料，或先在預備環境測試。

cues.en: before heading to production, or amend this downgrade command so that you keep the table, but remove any constraints or comment out this destructive command.
cues.zh: 再進入正式環境；也可以修改 downgrade，保留表但移除約束，或註解掉這個破壞性命令。

cues.en: With that being said, let's proceed.
cues.zh: 接著繼續。

cues.en: So you're going to close this.
cues.zh: 關閉這個檔案。

cues.en: Then in our next of kin service, we're going to add a function that will allow authenticated users to get all the next of kin.
cues.zh: 在近親服務加入函式，讓已驗證的使用者取得所有近親資料。

cues.en: So you're going to open next of kin within backend up API services.
cues.zh: 開啟 backend/app/api/services 裡的 next_of_kin。

cues.en: Then let's scroll to the bottom so you can see here async get underscore user next of kin.
cues.zh: 捲動到最下面，定義 async def get_user_next_of_kins。

cues.en: This is going to take in the user ID that's going to be of type Uuid.
cues.zh: 接收 user_id，型別為 UUID。

cues.en: And then the session that's going to be async session.
cues.zh: session 的型別為 AsyncSession。

cues.en: Then this function is going to return a list of next of kin.
cues.zh: 函式回傳 NextOfKin 清單。

cues.en: Then as usual we're going to have a try block.
cues.zh: 一樣建立 try 區塊。

cues.en: So you can say try.
cues.zh: 寫 try。

cues.en: Then we're going to query the database by using statement.
cues.zh: 接著查詢資料庫，設定 statement。

cues.en: That's going to be select next of kin where the next of kin dot user id is equals to the user id that is passed as an argument to the function.
cues.zh: select(NextOfKin)，條件為 NextOfKin.user_id 等於傳入函式的 user_id。

cues.en: Then the result that's going to be await session dot execute on the statement.
cues.zh: 接著用 await session.execute(statement) 查詢近親資料，將結果存為 result。

cues.en: Then the next of kins.
cues.zh: 接著是 next_of_kins。

cues.en: That's going to be a list of all the results.
cues.zh: 它是所有結果的清單。

cues.en: So you can say result dot all.
cues.zh: 使用 result.all()。

cues.en: Then we can just return the next of kins like that.
cues.zh: 接著直接回傳 next_of_kins。

cues.en: Then as usual we're going to have the accept block so I can just copy it from up above.
cues.zh: 一樣加入 except 區塊，可以從上面複製。

cues.en: Come back right there.
cues.zh: 回到這裡。

cues.en: Paste it in.
cues.zh: 貼上。

cues.en: So in case of any exceptions we're going to log an error and we can say failed to retrieve next of kins like that.
cues.zh: 若有例外，就記錄錯誤，訊息寫「無法取得近親資料」。

cues.en: Then the status code is 500 status error.
cues.zh: 狀態碼為 500，status 為 error。

cues.en: The message is going to be failed to get user next of kins.
cues.zh: message 為「無法取得使用者的近親資料」。

cues.en: Just like that.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: Then you can save the file.
cues.zh: 儲存檔案。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: That marks the end of this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture we shall be handling the next of kins routes.
cues.zh: 下一堂處理近親資料路由。
